facts.fact: Egypt's Supreme Cybersecurity Council strategy says e-signature rests on a PKI run through the ITIDA Egyptian Root CA and the Ministry of Finance's Government Electronic Certification Authority; as_of is the document's November 2018 update date.
facts.system: ITIDA Egyptian Root CA and Gov-CA

facts.fact: The strategy says e-signature services are also provided by companies licensed by ITIDA, alongside the Root CA and the Gov-CA; as_of is the document's November 2018 update date.
